set.layering_notes: Reclassified from other to negative finding in the 5_audit pass: the HCD Napa County Farmworker Centers Account (Health and Safety Code 50711.5) is an annual state match of up to $250,000 paid only to the Napa County Housing Authority for operating its own three farmworker centers, funded from the SB 2 Building Homes and Jobs Trust Fund, with an equal local match required; nothing is deployable to outside developers. Napa's only county housing authority is a farmworker-center operator with no Housing Choice Vouchers or development lending; the public housing agency for the county is the Housing Authority of the City of Napa. Farmworker rental projects in Napa instead layer the state Joe Serna Jr. Farmworker Housing Grant, the State Farmworker Housing Tax Credit (Pass 1) and the County Affordable Housing Fund, which once reserved $2,000,000 for farmworker projects and whose fees exempt farmworker units of 1,200 sq ft or less. The 2024 Napa County Farmworker Housing Needs and Impacts Assessment found 16% of year-round and 26% of seasonal workers in overcrowded housing. napacounty.gov is Cloudflare-blocked; the Authority page is https://www.napacounty.gov/467/Housing-Authority (707-253-4112). AB 1890 figures were not re-checked in this audit.

reason: Statute confirms the $250,000 annual match goes only to the County Housing Authority's own centers, so funding_type is reclassified from other to negative finding for developers.
